messages:
Lena (AE): Team — Arboretum Health sent an RFI. We need: capability matrix, answers on KMS/HSM, data residency, POC timeline, and pricing options. Legal wants SOC2 evidence and encryption details. Can SEs and finance help?
Marco (SE): I can own the capability matrix and KMS writeup. Clarify: do they require an on-prem private control plane or is VPC-only acceptable? Also what throughput/latency do they expect for the POC?
Lena (AE): They prefer private deployment but will accept VPC if tenancy/isolation is guaranteed. Targets: ~200 qps embeddings, ~50 qps chat. P50 latency <120ms. Pricing: reserved commit vs burst comparison + rough numbers.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Starting a capability matrix draft with columns: Feature | Supported | Notes. Also creating RFI answers doc for security and architecture.
ops-bot: uploaded capability_matrix_arbor_v1.pdf to thread — https://files.redwood/capability_matrix_arbor_v1.pdf
Marco (SE): KMS support: customer-managed keys with HSM-backed wrapping (cloud HSM or customer HSM). Snippet: "KMS: customer-managed; HSM: optional; envelope-encryption: supported; key-rotation: automated or customer-controlled."
Priya (Solutions Eng): Security questionnaire flagged FedRAMP and EU data residency. We are not FedRAMP certified. Propose FedRAMP roadmap + compensating controls? They also asked for SLA (99.9) and dedicated capacity for the POC.
Lena (AE): Not certified today. Propose a 9-12 month FedRAMP assessment estimate plus interim controls (private VPC deployment, continuous audit logging, SSP readiness checklist). Priya/Marco, can you draft that language?
Marco (SE): Drafted FedRAMP roadmap paragraph with interim controls. Sketched a 3-week POC plan: Week 1 integration & connectivity (auth, KMS, sample data); Week 2 perf/throughput + embedding accuracy checks; Week 3 security review, SOC2 artifacts review, and handover. Will attach runbook.
Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll request a representative test dataset and infra contact. For pricing propose two options: (A) Dedicated 3-month reserved commit (predictable throughput, capacity isolation); (B) Hosted with burst/overflow (pay-as-you-go) for evaluation. Finance to add exact rates.
Sam (Finance): Send expected token counts and embedding units and I'll model both options. Note: quantization profile can reduce embedding costs by ~25-35% for this workload — call this out.
Lena (AE): Next steps: Marco attach KMS + POC runbook, Priya finalize capability matrix + RFI answers, Sam provide pricing numbers. Target sending the full RFI packet by EOD Thursday.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Ack. I'll request SOC2 attestation PDF from Legal and ask Security to add SSP controls.
Marco (SE): Attached to thread: rfi_answers_arbor_v1.docx, kms_summary.txt, poc_runbook_weekly.md
ops-bot: uploaded rfi_answers_arbor_v1.docx and kms_summary.txt and poc_runbook_weekly.md — https://files.redwood/rfi_answers_arbor_v1.docx
Lena (AE): Thanks — I'll consolidate and send to Arboretum procurement. If EU residency mapping or KMS certs block, flag here immediately.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Flagging a potential blocker: their security team requested specific HSM vendor certificates for on-prem HSMs — may need partner coordination.
Sam (Finance): I'll have pricing models by tomorrow afternoon.
Lena (AE): Great. Keeping this thread live for updates.
